content.title: RELATIONAL DATABASES & CHANGE DATA CAPTURE
content.content:
SnapLogic offers enterprise-grade JDBC-based connection capabilities for all major relational databases relevant to Airbus Helicopters' environment. All database connections are established from the Ground Plex to the database server — fully within AH's network.

- **Oracle Database v12c+**: Native JDBC connector for read/write/upsert + full CDC. CDC mode (Change Tracking, Change Capture, LogMiner) — captures INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, DDL changes in real time. Oracle Exadata is supported via the same Oracle JDBC and CDC stack (Exadata presents a standard Oracle interface to JDBC clients).

- **Microsoft SQL Server v2012+**: Native JDBC driver (Snap Pack JDBC). CDC (MSSQL-based Change Tracking) — captures row-level changes per table with LSN-based watermarking.

- **PostgreSQL v9.5+**: Native PostgreSQL Snap Pack (JDBC). CDC via PostgreSQL logical replication (pgoutput plugin) — supports all DML operations with consistent ordering.

- **MySQL v5+ / MariaDB v5.5+**: Native MySQL/MariaDB Snap Pack (JDBC). CDC via binary log (binlog) replication — captures row-level changes with microsecond timestamp.

- **SAP HANA**: Native SAP HANA JDBC connector with SQL/MDX query support. Used to extract data from SAP systems into downstream analytics/reporting flows.

- **Generic JDBC**: Universal JDBC connector for any JDBC-compliant database. Supports Db2/400 in process analytical (bi), SAP HANA, IBM DB2, Teradata, and others via standard JDBC URLs and JDBC drivers installed in the Ground Plex.

- **MongoDB v6+, Neo4j v4/5+**: Native NoSQL connectors: MongoDB Snap Pack supports v5.12+, Splunk Enterprise v7.x+: Native connectors for document, graph, search, and analytics stores
